chunks: There are those who built a mosque on opposition and disbelief, and to cause rifts among the faithful, and to serve as an outpost for those who have warred against God and His Apostle before this. Yet they will surely swear: "We had only meant well." But God is witness that they are liars.

key_terms.لِمَنْ حَارَبَ اللَّهَ: for those who warred against God

ai.seo_question: Who built the Mosque of Quba' for hypocrisy and what was their true intention?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the Mosque of Quba' (Masjid al-Dhirar) as a strategic base for the hypocrites, particularly Usayd ibn al-Hadrami, to undermine Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) and sow discord. The divine testimony of their deceitfulness underscores the contrast between their outward claims of piety and their inner intent to facilitate the return of the Quraysh chief, Abu Sufyan, against the Muslim community.
